note: Tiny in-repo eval set (smoke-scale, NOT a statistically meaningful benchmark). Each query lists the doc ids that answer it. Mixes paraphrase, exact-term and multi-aspect queries; one romanised-Hindi and one code-ish query. Extend before drawing conclusions.

docs.d01: Pgvector stores embeddings in a vector column and supports cosine distance with an ivfflat or hnsw index.
docs.d02: Flyway applies versioned SQL migrations in order; each tenant schema runs the same migration set.
docs.d03: The Whisper model transcribes speech to text on CPU; long audio is split into thirty second windows.
docs.d04: Cross-encoder rerankers score a query and passage jointly, which is more accurate than bi-encoders but cannot be precomputed.
docs.d05: Zero padding a 384 dimension vector to 768 dimensions does not change its direction or its cosine similarity.
docs.d06: OAuth refresh tokens let a client obtain new access tokens without asking the user to sign in again.
docs.d07: Chunking splits long documents into overlapping passages so each embedding captures one idea.
docs.d08: Reciprocal rank fusion merges the ranked lists from keyword search and vector search into one ranking.
docs.d09: A circuit breaker stops calling a failing service for a cooldown period, then probes it with a single request.
docs.d10: Tesseract performs optical character recognition on scanned images and returns plain text.
docs.d11: Server sent events stream tokens from the model to the browser one chunk at a time.
docs.d12: Rate limiting with a token bucket allows short bursts while enforcing an average request rate.
docs.d13: ColBERT keeps one vector per token and scores relevance with MaxSim: each query token takes its best match among document tokens.
docs.d14: Docker containers share the host kernel, so they start faster than virtual machines but isolate less.
docs.d15: Garbage collection pauses in the JVM can be reduced by tuning the heap size and choosing the G1 collector.
docs.d16: Bayesian optimisation models an expensive objective with a Gaussian process and picks the next point by expected improvement.
docs.d17: Citations in a research answer should quote the exact span of the source that supports the claim.

docs.d19: def retry(fn, attempts=3): loops and calls fn, sleeping with exponential backoff between failures.
